answer: An agent must register by locking a nontrivial bond in an escrow contract, then answer unpredictable, publicly verifiable tasks whose results are cross-checked by randomly selected bonded agents. If several identities coordinate to approve the same false claim, a later fraud proof identifies the colluding signatures and slashes their bonds, while honest challengers are paid. Creating a Sybil swarm therefore requires one bond per identity and exposes every fake vote to capital loss; names like dune, shale, and vine add no weight.
